ui:help.en: OpenAI Platform API key, sent as Authorization: Bearer. Stored encrypted and never shown again.
ui:help.zh: OpenAI 平台的 API Key，以 Authorization: Bearer 发送；加密保存，保存后不再明文显示。

ui:help.en: Leave the default for OpenAI, or enter an OpenAI-compatible endpoint; requests go to <Base URL>/v1/chat/completions, /v1/responses and /v1/embeddings. A trailing /v1 is removed.
ui:help.zh: 使用 OpenAI 官方接口时保持默认；也可以填写 OpenAI 兼容端点，请求发往 <Base URL>/v1/chat/completions、/v1/responses、/v1/embeddings。末尾的 /v1 会被去掉。

ui:help.en: Rewrite the requested model before forwarding, e.g. gpt-4o* -> gpt-4.1. Exact names win over wildcards.
ui:help.zh: 转发前改写请求的模型，例如 gpt-4o* -> gpt-4.1。精确名称优先于通配符。
